title: Year-of-death RMD where death PRECEDED the RBD
catches: Reporting 'not_satisfied' when no year-of-death RMD was ever due.
notes: No year-of-death RMD exists unless the owner died on or after the RBD. decedentRBDStatus gates the entire subsection. Reporting 'not_satisfied' here invents a deficiency and will alarm a client for no reason.
